description: Defines the class 'phy_metrics_ulsch_demultiplex_decorator', a decorator for UL-SCH demultiplexer that measures resource usage metrics and notifies a metrics collector.

classes.name: phy_metrics_ulsch_demultiplex_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for UL-SCH demultiplexer that adds resource usage measurement and metrics notification.

methods.name: phy_metrics_ulsch_demultiplex_decorator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a base demultiplexer and a notifier.

methods.name: set_csi_part2
methods.description: Sets CSI part 2 data in the base demultiplexer.

methods.name: demultiplex
methods.description: Performs demultiplexing while measuring resource usage and timing, and stores the base buffer.

methods.name: get_next_block_view
methods.description: Returns the next block view from the base buffer.

methods.name: on_new_block
methods.description: Processes a new block of data, measures resource usage, and updates counters.

methods.name: on_end_codeword
methods.description: Finalizes codeword processing, measures resource usage, and notifies metrics.
